symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Incident window shows 6 of 11 checkouts failed: gateway-mock answered 429 TooManyRequests to payment-service /authorize (D20, D22), and payment-service recorded those payments FAILED (D12, D41). Requests that got 200 succeeded. No restarts, no errors in any service, and latency stayed normal (D25-D37). gateway-mock rejects requests with 429 under load, so the root cause is gateway-mock rejecting. Category DEPENDENCY_REJECTING, confidence moderately high.
